title: THE MAGICAL WORLD
episode_name: The Boy Without a Magic Signature
story_origin: Original expansion of the ten supplied section headings; no complete earlier screenplay was present in the supplied brief.

kael.name: Kael Ardyn
kael.outfit: dark navy long coat, charcoal trousers, pale shirt
kael.voice: young adult Indian English male, restrained and expressive

mira.name: Mira Veyne
mira.voice: young adult Indian English female, clear and confident

riven.name: Riven Sol

city.route: lower canal bridge to uphill market

academy.route: gate and three broad entry steps

courtyard.route: same courtyard after the arch and dais are damaged

ruins.route: short fifteen-metre approach from the boundary wall to the tower doorway

tower.route: a short spiral stair directly into the underground chamber

seal.route: the same stair provides the return path

shots.description: Dawn reveals Aetheria's suspended aqueducts and crystal-powered terraces; Kael crosses the lower bridge toward the Academy.
action_beats: Dawn touches the tallest crystal spire
Aether currents illuminate the suspended aqueduct
Camera descends toward the lower bridge
Kael steps into the bridge's morning light
He looks up at the distant Academy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In Aetheria, magic flowed through every street, every stone, and every living soul.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Every soul except mine.

shots.description: Kael passes a fountain whose silver water rises in an impossible spiral; he catches a falling flower before it reaches the canal.
action_beats: Kael follows the fountain's outer curve
The enchanted water curls above him
A flower slips from the rising current
Kael reaches across the railing and catches it
He sets it safely on a dry stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A person's magic signature shaped their place in the world. Kael's had never appeared.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: At least flowers don't ask questions.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: An academy courier cart blocks the narrow market lane. Riven vaults its axle on a controlled spark while Kael waits for a clear path.
shots.expression: Riven playful pride; Kael patient reserve
action_beats: Riven runs into view beside the stalled cart
Crimson sparks gather beneath his boot
He vaults the low axle without touching the cargo
Kael waits until the cart rolls past
The two fall into step along the market

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Ardyn! Ceremony day. Ready to surprise everyone?

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: I would settle for not surprising the crystal.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: Mira joins the boys beneath a hanging sign, quietly fastening a loose strap on Kael's satchel with a silver thread.
shots.expression: Mira observant warmth; Kael embarrassed gratitude
action_beats: Mira steps out from the bookstall awning
She notices Kael's fraying satchel strap
A fine silver thread loops through the seam
Kael lifts the repaired strap and tests it
Riven grins as all three continue uphill

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Your bag is coming apart. Hold still.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Thanks. It has survived nineteen years of being ordinary.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: The street opens onto the Academy approach; its ceremonial banners rise toward a sealed tower standing beyond the courtyard.
action_beats: The group rounds the final market corner
Academy banners appear beyond the roofline
Kael slows at the sight of the ceremonial crystal
Mira matches his pace instead of passing him
A dark sealed tower catches Kael's attention

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: A signature describes power. It cannot describe everything a person is.

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Tell that to the examination board.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: They cross the Academy gate. A faint pulse passes through the old tower's stonework; only Kael turns toward it.
shots.expression: Kael unsettled recognition; Elder concealed concern
action_beats: The three cross beneath the Academy gate
The sealed tower sends out a nearly invisible ring
Kael stops with one foot on the courtyard step
Mira looks back and reaches toward his sleeve
The Elder notices Kael staring at the tower

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Did either of you hear that bell?

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: No bell rang. Kael, are you all right?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: At the courtyard edge, Kael turns his bare wrist under the light; the other students' signature marks glow through their cuffs.
action_beats: Kael pulls back his navy sleeve
His unmarked wrist catches the morning light
Riven's red signature flickers beside it
Kael closes his fingers and lowers his arm
Mira stands beside him rather than ahead

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Every year they say it might awaken late. Every year, the same empty hand.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Today is still today.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: Riven lets a harmless spark dance above one knuckle, then extinguishes it when he sees Kael's expression.
shots.expression: Riven's confidence gives way to sincerity
action_beats: Riven raises a small crimson spark
Kael watches without reaching for it
Riven notices the hurt under Kael's smile
He closes his hand and extinguishes the spark
Kael answers with a small genuine grin

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: I complain about control lessons. You would probably work harder than all of us.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Probably?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: A younger student's ceremonial ribbon blows toward a drainage grate. Kael catches it while the others are distracted by the crystal procession.
action_beats: A loose ribbon lifts into the breeze
Kael hears a small gasp behind him
He changes direction and lunges toward the grate
His hand catches the ribbon above the dark opening
He returns it and kneels to its owner's height

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: You noticed the ribbon before anyone noticed the child.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Someone had to. Magic isn't necessary for looking.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: The Elder pauses beside Kael and studies his empty wrist; Kael notices the same woven symbol engraved on the gold staff and the old tower.
shots.expression: Elder solemn secrecy; Kael direct curiosity
action_beats: The Elder's staff stops beside Kael's boot
Kael rises and straightens his coat
The Elder studies the unmarked wrist
Kael follows the staff's woven engraving
He looks from the symbol to the old tower

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Ardyn. Your mother stood here once, with that same stubborn expression.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: You knew her?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Before the Elder can answer, the ceremony horn calls. He withdraws, leaving Kael with a warning that sounds more personal than official.
action_beats: The Elder opens his mouth to explain
The ceremonial horn interrupts him
He lowers his voice and meets Kael's gaze
Kael takes half a step after him
Mira watches the Elder retreat toward the dais

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Whatever the crystal shows, do not mistake its answer for your worth.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Why does that sound like a warning?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: Kael pauses at the edge of the forming circle, remembers the ribbon he returned, and joins his friends without hiding his empty wrist.
shots.expression: Kael nervous courage; friends quiet solidarity
action_beats: Kael stops beside the final courtyard step
He sees the rescued ribbon flutter beyond the circle
His closed hand relaxes at his side
Mira and Riven leave an open space between them
Kael steps into that space with his wrist uncovered

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Whatever happens in there, you are still walking back with us.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Good. I would hate to miss more complaints.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: Students form a ring around the awakening crystal. Kael takes his place between Mira and Riven while the Elder raises his staff.
action_beats: Students settle into the circular formation
Mira moves into the place beside Kael
Riven gives him a quick reassuring nod
The Elder raises the gold staff above the dais
The awakening crystal begins to resonate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the Academy, the awakening crystal gave every gift a name. Today, it would meet an absence.

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Let the ceremony begin.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: Mira places her palm on the crystal. Silver filaments form a precise constellation, then return neatly to her wrist.
shots.expression: Mira focused confidence; Kael proud admiration
action_beats: Mira approaches the crystal with an even stride
Her palm meets the luminous surface
Silver filaments unfold around her hand
The filaments settle into a stable constellation
She withdraws and glances encouragingly at Kael

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Mira Veyne. Silver Thread Manipulation. Precision beyond your years.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Threads hold best when they share the weight.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Riven's test sends red lightning around the dais, but he catches the wild arc before it can strike a banner.
action_beats: Riven rolls his shoulder and steps onto the dais
He presses a confident palm against the crystal
A red arc whips above the nearest banner
Riven catches the arc between two fingers
He releases the current safely into the stone

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Riven Sol. Crimson Lightning. Consider restraint an essential part of strength.

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: That was the restrained version.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael walks alone to the crystal, steadying his hand before he places it on the same surface that answered his friends.
action_beats: Kael leaves the circle and approaches the dais
His hand trembles above the crystal
He hears Mira and takes a slow breath
His fingers spread against the surface
The courtyard waits for an answering light

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Breathe, Kael. You are not standing there alone.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Then let it see me. Whatever I am.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: The crystal goes completely dark around Kael's hand. Instead of a signature, fine cracks appear underneath its surface.
action_beats: The crystal's glow contracts beneath Kael's fingers
The last colour drains from the inner facets
Kael lowers his eyes toward his empty wrist
A hairline fracture moves against the light
The Elder steps sharply toward the dais

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Nothing. I knew it would be nothing.

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Take your hand away. Slowly. Do not pull against it.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael withdraws his hand. The dark fracture follows his fingertips like an unfinished line before vanishing into the crystal.
shots.expression: Kael frightened wonder; Mira analytical alarm
action_beats: Kael eases his palm away from the surface
A thin dark line follows his fingertips
Mira leans forward to see its changing shape
The Elder blocks her path with his staff
The line snaps back into the crystal

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: That wasn't an empty reading. Something moved inside the silence.

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: Everyone, step back from the dais.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: The first crack sounds overhead, not from the crystal. A narrow violet fault opens across the blue sky above the Academy.
action_beats: The crystal's fracture falls suddenly silent
A sharp crack draws every face upward
A violet line cuts across the sky
Clouds bend toward the impossible opening
The courtyard banners pull toward the growing rift

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: That sound came from above us.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: For the first time in three hundred years, the sky forgot how to hold together.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: The sky fault widens into a rotating rift. The Elder strikes his staff into the dais and raises a golden ward above the students.
action_beats: The rift widens beyond the roofline
Loose leaves spiral upward from the court
The Elder plants his staff into the dais
A golden ward spreads over the nearest students
Mira points the evacuation toward the covered passage

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: To the covered passage! Keep the younger students between you!

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Riven, take the east side. I have the stairs.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: Mira lays silver handrails across the damaged steps while Riven grounds a falling metal banner pole away from the crowd.
shots.expression: Mira decisive focus; Riven protective urgency
action_beats: Mira sweeps one arm along the broken staircase
Silver threads form a continuous temporary handrail
Riven spots the falling banner pole
A controlled crimson arc diverts it toward empty paving
Kael leads the last hesitant students onto the stairs

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Hold the silver line and keep moving! No one runs ahead!

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: The passage is clear. Bring them through!

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: A wraith of fractured violet armour descends from the rift and strikes the empty ceremonial dais, scattering crystal shards.
action_beats: A narrow shadow separates from the rift
Violet armour plates assemble around the descending shape
The wraith strikes the abandoned dais
Crystal shards skid across the court
Mira spots the moving gap inside its chest

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: That thing isn't made of flesh.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Its shape is borrowed. Watch the dark gap beneath its armour.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Riven intercepts the wraith with a short lightning strike; its armour opens to let the bolt pass and seals immediately behind it.
action_beats: Riven runs across the cleared paving
Crimson current gathers along his forearm
He releases a narrow bolt at the wraith's chest
The armour parts and the bolt passes through empty space
Riven lands and changes his footing instead of firing again

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Fine. Let us see how borrowed armour handles lightning!

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Stop! It opens around the strike, then closes again!

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: The failed strike tears a weakened arch loose. Kael sees a student trapped beneath its lower beam while the Elder braces the collapsing ward.
shots.expression: Kael immediate concern; Elder strained concentration
action_beats: The wraith's displaced energy hits the damaged arch
A lower beam drops across the escape route
Kael notices a trapped hand beneath the dust
The Elder braces the overhead ward with both hands
Kael turns away from safety and toward the ruins

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Someone is still under that arch!

dialogue.speaker: elder
dialogue.text: I cannot leave the ward. The entire passage would fall!

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael runs beneath falling dust toward the trapped student while Mira and Riven keep the wraith away from his path.
shots.expression: Kael fierce resolve; Mira worried trust
action_beats: Kael ducks under a hanging stone fragment
He sprints toward the trapped student's hand
Mira turns a silver thread into the wraith's path
Riven circles to draw the creature's next strike
Kael slides to his knees beside the fallen beam

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Kael, wait for a shield!

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: There isn't time. Keep its eyes on you, not the arch!

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael tests the beam with his shoulder, finds it too heavy, and searches the rubble for a usable lever instead of forcing it.
action_beats: Kael presses his shoulder beneath the fallen beam
The weight drives him back onto one knee
He changes his grip instead of abandoning the student
His eyes find a broken iron banner bracket
He reaches across the rubble for the bracket

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Look at me. We do this together. Tell me when your foot is free.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He had no spell. He had a choice.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael wedges the iron bracket beneath the beam. Mira catches it with a silver thread, stabilising the fulcrum while he levers the stone upward.
shots.expression: Kael concentrated effort; Mira absolute focus
action_beats: Kael drives the iron bracket into the gap
Mira anchors a thread around the shifting fulcrum
Kael bears down on the bracket with both hands
The stone rises just enough to release the trapped foot
Mira keeps the beam steady as the student crawls free

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: I can steady it, but I cannot carry the whole beam.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Then steady it. I will do the lifting.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael carries the freed student toward the passage. Riven slides between them and the wraith, blocking its descending claw with a grounded lightning arc.
shots.expression: Kael relieved urgency; Riven protective ferocity
action_beats: Kael lifts the student's arm over his shoulder
They move toward the covered passage
The wraith lunges toward their unguarded backs
Riven slides across the paving and raises a grounded arc
Kael passes the student into Mira's waiting hands

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: You got them out? Good. Now get yourself out!

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Not while you are still standing here alone.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: The wraith presses through Riven's guard and sends him skidding. Kael steps into the open space before the creature can follow.
action_beats: The wraith pushes its claw through the edge of the arc
Riven loses his footing on the broken stone
He skids away and catches himself on one hand
Kael steps between the wraith and his fallen friend
The creature turns its empty face toward Kael

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Kael, you cannot block that!

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: I know. But I can make it look at me.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.

shots.description: A pressure wave throws Kael against the old tower's boundary wall. His unmarked wrist touches a buried woven symbol, and the noise of battle falls away.
action_beats: The wraith releases a pressure wave across the ruins
Kael is thrown backward toward the old boundary wall
His palm lands on an engraved stone beneath the dust
An unfinished woven mark lights beneath his wrist
The surrounding battle becomes distant and muffled

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Kael! Stay with us!

dialogue.speaker: ancient
dialogue.text: At last. A hand without a name, at the door without a key.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael remains against the wall as fine luminous lines emerge from ordinary stone, linking the rubble, his coat, and the distant ward.
action_beats: Kael lifts his head from the boundary stone
A pale line appears beneath the broken paving
More lines reveal the edges of the shattered arch
He follows a line into the seam of his own sleeve
The lines converge around his still-unmarked wrist

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Who is there? Why can I see lines inside everything?

dialogue.speaker: ancient
dialogue.text: Because you are listening beneath the signatures, not above them.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: The lines align with memories of his mother's woven wrist ribbon, then return to the present ruins without changing his physical location.
action_beats: Kael touches the old ribbon inside his cuff
Its familiar weave aligns with the glowing stone pattern
A remembered hand briefly overlays his own
Kael's fingers close around the ribbon
The memory fades while the present-day lines remain

dialogue.speaker: ancient
dialogue.text: Your mother did not leave you powerless. She hid your beginning from those who would claim it.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: She was protecting me?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: A broken stone fragment rises between Kael's hands as he involuntarily follows two intersecting origin lines; he lets it fall when the voice names the cost.
action_beats: Kael follows two crossing lines with his fingertips
A small stone fragment rises between his hands
The lines tighten around his wrist
He feels a sudden pressure behind his eyes
He releases the fragment and it settles into the dust

dialogue.speaker: ancient
dialogue.text: Origin Weaving changes what magic connects. Every new connection asks something of its maker.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: What does it ask?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: The Ancient Voice makes its offer as the ward visibly fractures beyond Kael's shoulder. He sees his friends still fighting through the translucent lines.
action_beats: The glowing lines pull into a ring before Kael
A fracture crosses the distant golden ward
Mira and Riven remain visible through the ring
Kael watches them hold the same failing defensive line
He sets his palm against the unfinished origin mark

dialogue.speaker: ancient
dialogue.text: A memory. A promise. Perhaps a name. Open the first seal, and I will lend you a beginning.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: No stolen lives?

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael refuses the promise of limitless power and chooses a single connection to the broken arch, testing the terms rather than surrendering himself.
action_beats: The offered ring expands toward Kael's chest
He pushes its far edge away with an open hand
He selects one loose origin line instead of the whole ring
That line reaches toward the broken arch
He draws a single controlled breath and stands

dialogue.speaker: ancient
dialogue.text: Only what you choose to weave. Only what you agree to pay.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Then I choose one chance to help them.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Battle sound returns. Kael rises from the wall and sees a precise origin line running through the loose iron bracket beside Mira's damaged handrail.
shots.expression: Kael newly focused; Mira startled hope
action_beats: Full battle sound returns around Kael
He pushes away from the engraved boundary wall
Mira turns while keeping her silver thread taut
Kael follows the origin line through the iron bracket
He approaches with his hand held open and steady

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: You are standing. How are you standing?

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Mira, keep your thread on the bracket. I can see where it wants to go.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: Kael connects the bracket's origin line to the fallen beam; the lifted weight shifts into the surviving arch foundation instead of Mira's exhausted hand.
action_beats: Kael takes the bracket's pale origin line between two fingers
Mira holds her silver thread still for him
He guides the pale line toward the surviving foundation
The beam's weight settles into the intact stone
Mira's strained arm lowers as the load leaves it

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: Not stronger. Connected differently. The foundation can hold what your hand cannot.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Then show me the connection.

continuity.preserve: Character identities, outfits, injury state, magic colours and movement direction persist across the connected shots.
continuity.entrance: Continue the prior shot's final action; any change of location is shown along the established route.

shots.description: The unfinished mark lights on Kael's wrist for the first time. He sways as a familiar melody leaves his memory, then steadies himself against the repaired foundation.
action_beats: The completed connection pulses through the foundation
A faint woven mark appears on Kael's wrist
Riven notices it and lowers his guarded fist
Kael reaches instinctively for the ribbon in his cuff
He sways and steadies himself against the repaired stone

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Your hand, Kael. That is definitely not nothing.

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: There was a song I used to know. Why can't I remember it?

dialogue.speaker: kael
dialogue.text: I lost it. The lines keep moving!

dialogue.speaker: riven

dialogue.speaker: kael

dialogue.speaker: riven
dialogue.text: Your turn to be rescued, Ardyn!
